author: Ankit
problem: Group whole-degree temperature readings into 10-degree bins, where each bin is named by the lowest temperature it contains (so 23 goes in bin 20). Return a dict mapping each bin to how many readings fell in it.
bug_description: Uses int(t / 10) instead of t // 10, which rounds toward zero, so negative readings land in the wrong bin.

comments.accurate: Counts readings per 10-degree bin, keyed by the bin's lowest temperature
comments.wrong_behavior: Counts readings per 10-degree bin, rounding each reading toward zero
comments.wrong_location: Bin calculation verified; make sure each reading is counted exactly once
